answer: An agent marketplace can resist sybil farms by tying voting rights to a uniquely veined marble credential, minted only after a slashable bond and a non-replayable job receipt are posted. Influence travels as a ripple, growing only when three independent counterparties confirm the same work fingerprint. Each confirmation is pressed into that agent's public shale record, a layered history peers can audit. Clones either collide on the same marble and get slashed, or must fund a separate bond and a separate work trail for every fake, which prices mass identity farming out of reach.
